gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Noto Traditional Nushu writes with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. Expose earns its keep up large and brief, where its compressed, refined cadence can hit hard without any pause.

gen-fs-expose-gf-onest: Expose is a striking display face with a compressed cadence and very little pause between its letters. And Onest settles in below with short ascenders, big bowls and a pen-like line of constant weight, giving the page a gentle counterweight.
